title: 第474章 小丑天道疯狂哭唧唧第473章 天道 你们不要再打辣
slug: 穿越庶长兄嫡弟竟是仙帝转世
content_zh:
两人对视片刻，同时移开目光。
算了，都没抢过的败家，没必要互相伤害。
反正输给元煌仙帝，不丢人。
若真抢赢了，那才可怕。说明那位可能在憋别的大的。
两只新生的十二都天魔已死，至尊博弈落幕，心晶也没了。三方此行的目的，至少明面上已经结束。
没什么可再僵持拉扯的必要了，于是三家人马各自默默收拾阵器，准备散场离去，各回山门。
众人边收边满怀心事。冰神宫与天机阁要回去商议，如何从云氏那里资源置换，重新争取到心晶，或是漫天撒网继续狩猎十二都天魔。
云氏则要回去清点此战损耗与战功，还有魔墟、圣主，云擎窥探到的诸天神战这些消息。
一场大战虽止，真正的暗潮才刚起。
云擎心下叹了口气，也准备随云氏长老们返程。
结果他刚转身，掌心沉寂许久的仙庭印骤然炸锅！一股委屈至极的天道意念顺着仙庭印就扑了过来。
“你们打完了？！你们要走了？！那我呢——！你们不管我了是吗？！！”
天元天道疯狂哭唧唧的在云擎识海中上蹿下跳，疯狂控诉，活脱脱一个被负心人抛弃在界壁边缘的小可怜。
“……什么玩意？！”云擎脚步猛地一顿，差点原地跳起来
他抬头，看向天元壁之外，这才忽然想起一件被三家全员彻底遗忘的大事。
当初为了诱杀紫宸长公主与穆老，三宗联手将两大天魔引入天元境内，同时以界壁硬生生隔绝、拦截了域外铺天盖地的天魔大军！
之后三宗忙着围杀双魔、忙着互相拉扯抢机缘，又逢星见、冰主、云煌三尊现身，诸人忙着看三尊博弈抢心晶。
竟把最开始那件事给忘了。
那两尊新生都天魔是被扬成灰灰了没错，可界壁外还堵着无穷无尽的魔潮呢！
可怜天元天道独自扛了全程，一刻没歇，憋着气疯狂调动九霄神雷，噗嗤噗嗤地努力劈，硬生生独自硬扛了全场伤害。

劈到现在，还没劈完。
界壁之外，魔潮翻滚。无数低阶天魔撞在界壁上，被天道雷光劈成焦黑碎片。
可数量实在太多，劈完一层，还有十层。
劈得天道都快冒烟了。
仙庭印又委屈地狠狠震了一下。
云擎沉默片刻，心底难得生出几分微弱的良心愧疚。
“二长老。”他转头看向云渊。
云渊正准备带人回族地清点战功，闻言回头。
“怎么？”
云擎抬手指向界外。
“还有些尾巴。”
云渊顺着他指的方向一看，也沉默了。
片刻后，他若无其事道：“咳，差点忘了。”
云擎疯狂点头。
看完那三位的大战，谁还有心思管魔潮那种小角色啊。
到底是几方众人造的孽，云擎止住转身的脚步，回头唤住正要撤离的天机阁与冰神宫两方人马。
“两位且留步。”
霜仙子停步，星元子也转过身。冰嘻嘻、符三元同时看向云擎。
云擎笑得温和，声音清朗，
“走之前，劳烦诸位再搭把手。”

他抬手指了指界壁之外还在翻涌的魔潮。
“来都来了。”
“也请先清完外域魔潮，再各归山门。”
两宗众人闻言一怔，随即看向界壁之外哭笑不得。
罢了，来都来了，尊主也落败了。
content_en:
The two looked at each other for a moment, then looked away.
Forget it, there is no need to hurt each other if neither of them has been robbed.
Anyway, there is no shame in losing to Immortal Emperor Yuanhuang.
It would be terrible if he really won. It means that that person may be holding back the other big one.
The two newly born Twelve Capital Heavenly Demons are dead, the Supreme Game has come to an end, and the Heart Crystal is gone. The purpose of the trip between the three parties, at least on the surface, has come to an end.
There was no need for any more stalemate, so the three families quietly packed up their array weapons and prepared to leave and return to the mountain gate.
Everyone was filled with thoughts as they collected it. Ice God Palace and Tianji Pavilion will go back to discuss how to exchange resources from the Yun family, regain the heart crystal, or cast a net in the sky to continue hunting the twelve capital demons.
The Yun family will go back to take stock of the losses and achievements of this battle, as well as the information about the Demon Ruins, the Holy Lord, and the battle between the gods that Yun Qing spied on.
Although the war is over, the real undercurrent has just begun.
Yun Qing sighed inwardly and prepared to return with the Yun family elders.
As a result, as soon as he turned around, the Xianting Seal that had been silent for a long time suddenly exploded in his palm! An extremely aggrieved idea of ​​heaven rushed over along the Immortal Court Seal.
"You're done fighting?! Are you leaving?! What about me -! You don't care about me anymore, do you?!"
Tianyuan Tiandao was crying and jumping up and down in Yunqing's sea of ​​consciousness, complaining crazily, just like a pitiful little person who was abandoned by the unfaithful person on the edge of the boundary wall.
"...What the hell?!" Yun Qing's footsteps suddenly stopped and he almost jumped up on the spot.
He raised his head and looked outside the Tianyuan Wall, and then suddenly remembered an important event that had been completely forgotten by all the members of the three families.
In order to trap Princess Zichen and Elder Mu, the three sects teamed up to introduce the two demons into Tianyuan territory, and at the same time used boundary walls to forcibly isolate and intercept the overwhelming army of demons outside the territory!
After that, the three sects were busy surrounding and killing the two demons, and were busy trying to fight each other for opportunities. Then the three deities Xingjian, Ice Lord, and Yunhuang appeared, and everyone was busy watching the three deities competing for the heart crystal.
I actually forgot about the first thing.
It is true that the two newly born demons were turned into ashes, but there is still an endless wave of demons blocking the outside of the boundary wall!
Poor Tianyuan Tiandao carried the whole process alone, without resting for a moment. Holding his breath, he frantically mobilized the Nine Heavens Divine Thunder, banging and banging with all his strength, and endured all the damage by himself.
I haven't finished chopping yet.
Outside the boundary wall, the demonic tide rolled. Countless low-level demons hit the boundary wall and were split into charred black fragments by the lightning of heaven.
But there are too many. After one layer has been chopped, there are still ten layers left.
It was so hard that the sky was almost smoking.
Xiantingyin shook hard again in grievance.
Yun Qing was silent for a moment, feeling a faint sense of guilt in his heart.
"Second Elder." He turned to look at Yunyuan.
Yunyuan was about to take people back to his clan to count his military exploits, but turned around after hearing this.
"What?"
Yun Qing raised his hand and pointed out of bounds.
"And some tail."
Yun Yuan looked in the direction he pointed and fell silent.
After a moment, he said nonchalantly: "Ahem, I almost forgot."
Yun Qing nodded wildly.
After watching the battle between those three, who would care about a small character like Mo Chao?
After all, it was the fault of several people. Yun Qing stopped turning around and turned around to call back the people from Tianji Pavilion and Ice God Palace who were about to evacuate.
"You two, please stay."
Frost Fairy stopped and Xing Yuanzi also turned around. Bing Xixi and Fu Sanyuan looked at Yun Qing at the same time.
Yun Qing smiled gently and his voice was clear,
"Before I leave, could you please lend me a hand?"
He raised his hand and pointed at the demonic tide still surging outside the boundary wall.
"It's all here."
"Please also clear out the demonic tide in the outside world first, and then return to the mountain gate."
Everyone in the two sects was startled when they heard this, and then looked outside the boundary wall, dumbfounded.
Forget it, come here, the Lord has also been defeated.
